name: Surge AI
tagline: Premium human data and RLHF for frontier AI labs.
description: Surge AI provides high-quality human-generated training data and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for AI developers. It pairs a large network of expert annotators with a labeling platform and API to produce complex, specialized data — code, math, safety, and domain reasoning — used to train and align frontier models. Reported customers include OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta.
insight: Bootstrapped with no outside capital, Surge AI's ~$1.4B revenue in 2025 reportedly surpassed rival Scale AI.

modelSupport.notes: Human data and RLHF for any model; provider-independent.

edge: Premium expert-annotator model focused on complex RLHF and reasoning data for frontier labs, not high-volume commodity labeling.
pros: API plus platform for data delivery
cons: Aimed at large labs, not small teams

references.title: Surge AI seeks $1B raise as Scale AI loses customers and CEO to Meta
